summary: Whether you show it or not, you swing between a fast, restless mind and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you think and talk your way through anything; other days you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: Whether you show it or not, you swing between a fast, restless mind and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you think and talk your way through anything; other days you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes. The work is holding both without picking a side. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk. Speaking freely may not always feel easy. Thoughts can feel weighed against rules, consequences, or the fear of being wrong.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you build things that last and carry real weight.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel - or you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes.
integration: Let thinking and speech and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you build things that last work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
